import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import time
root = Path(sys.argv[1])
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from seal_n21 import P_BRANCH, seal_p, cut
previous = cut.read(root / 'P_G5_launch.json')
while not cut.terminal(previous):
    time.sleep(10)
receipt = P_BRANCH / 'G5/acceptance_summary.json'
if not receipt.is_file() or not cut.read(receipt)['passed']:
    print('Part P has no passed G5 receipt. Part W was not started.', flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(0)
seal_p()
argv = [cut.PYTHON, '-B', '-u', str(root / 'run_w_scoped.py')]
cut.save(root / 'W_scoped_launch.json', dict(cut.actual_identity(os.getpid()), actual_host_proc=True, argv=argv))
os.execv(cut.PYTHON, argv)
